scene.1: hobb|(from the door) Up, Button. Grant day. Nobody signs a deed on an empty stomach.
hobb|Sixteen years you've been staring at that wall. Never the nice bits. Always the damp.
hobb|I kept your basket, you know. Don't tell Dax. He'd want it for kindling.
hobb|Porridge. All of it. Then go and find Dax. He's been at the lock table since dawn.
scene.2: dax|Cellar. Sea chest. Older than the hall.
dax|Last lock in Saltgate you haven't tried.
dax|(chalking a cross on the lid) That's all of them, then.
dax|So it opens something that isn't here. Good thing you're leaving.
scene.3: mina|Plot forty-one. Greenhollow, south of Hollowmere. I looked it up before you asked.
mina|One dry field, one pond, and a sealed door in the hill. Nobody's ever opened one of those. Anywhere.
mina|And look. Last year's survey has the wood north of you green. This year's has it grey. I don't know why yet.
mina|(looking round at last) Write to me if the door does anything. It will not. Write anyway.
scene.4.before: dax|Go on. Hit me. Not the face. Hobb counts my teeth.
scene.4: dax|Go on. Hit me. Not the face. Hobb counts my teeth.
dax|(shaking out his arm) Fine. You'll do.
dax|I'm coming up anyway. Once you've got a roof.
grantday.bout: dax|(shaking out his arm) Fine. You'll do.
dax|I'm coming up anyway. Once you've got a roof.
scene.5: guildmaster|Ward of the guild, sixteen years. By right of the grant: plot forty-one, Greenhollow.
hobb|(quietly, behind you) Let them laugh. They'll all come visiting once you've got a kitchen.
scene.6: hobb|Bread, cheese, and a note on the back of your deed. Read it when you land. Not before.
dax|Don't open any doors till I get there.
hobb|(fixing your collar, which was fine) Go on, then, Button. Make it a home.
custodian.wake: custodian|A thousand years and sixty-one days late. I counted. There was nothing else to do.
custodian|Hand. Show me. (a long look) Yes. That is her mark. So it is you.
custodian|I am the Custodian. I kept this hall for Ilara. It seems I keep it for you now.
custodian|The fox, first. It is Blighted, not wicked. Hold out the hand.
heart.first: custodian|That is the Heartstone. It runs on what lives up there, on your land.
custodian|Every roof, every field, every beast that trusts you. It all comes down here.
custodian|(squinting at it) So far: one wet field and one fox. I have seen brighter puddles.
custodian|Her field book. It writes down whatever you take the trouble to watch.
custodian|Fill the stone and that arch wakes. Now sleep. You look the way the fox did.
hall.mural.asked: custodian|Do not ask me yet. I lost most of it. I only know that I am angry.
hall.gate.asked: custodian|A Gate. It is dead. Fill the stone and it wakes. Then it goes somewhere.
scene.15: tamsin|(looking at your hand) So it opened. I've walked past that door for years.
tamsin|Tamsin. The guild's warden here. I signed your grant. I should have met your boat.
tamsin|Wear it. In town, and above all near the priests of the Dawn.
tamsin|(watching the white coat go) Not that it'll help. He'll be at his bell by now.
scene.16: aldric|(out of breath) Is it true? No. Do not show me. She is coming herself.
elowen|Up, up. The grass is wet. You will all catch cold, and then who nurses you? I do.
elowen|(to you) May I see it? You may say no. People forget they may say no to me.
elowen|Forgive me. We have waited a very long time for that hand. All of us.
elowen|Set it in your field. Three crops where you now get one, and nothing to wind or mend.
elowen|And this is Calla. She is cleverer than she is gentle. Forgive her that.
calla|(not looking at Tamsin) I know these hills, Mother. I was taught well. For a while.
elowen|A god sleeps under the old terraces. Wake it when you are ready, and not before.
elowen|Then this valley will be well again. And then we shall talk, you and I.
scene.17: custodian|She was here. The old woman. I could smell her through the stone.
custodian|She smells like the old days. I do not know why that makes me want to bite.
custodian|That thing in your field hums. Nothing honest hums. Look at the stone.
custodian|You left her gift in its crate. Good. I cannot tell you why. Good.
custodian|I am coming with you. In the pack. I have sat on that plinth long enough.
scene.18: hobb|There you are, Button. Thin as a rake. I knew it. I said so to Dax.
dax|(setting the crate down) She did. Every mile of the river.
hobb|A miracle, they tell me. Miracles still eat breakfast. Where is your kitchen?
hobb|No kitchen. (rolling up her sleeves) Dax. The big pot.
dax|I'll sleep by the gate. Somebody should.
took.hobb.kitchen: hobb|A meal a day for everyone on this hill. That's what a kitchen's for.
took.hobb.smokehouse: hobb|Meals that keep for the road. So you're planning on going somewhere.
took.dax.yard: dax|Carry things from there to there. Fine.
scene.19: dax|Huh. (a pause) It's staying, isn't it.
scene.19.before: dax|(the crate's lid up, like a shield) I will hold it. You do the hand.
scene.20: wren|(softly, to the trees) Easy. It's only me. Same as yesterday.
wren|(to you, not turning) Stay behind me. He hasn't eaten in two winters. He doesn't know me now.
wren|His name is Bramble. I raised him on a bottle.
wren|I'm Wren. The queen's forester. For what that's worth out here.
scene.21.before: wren|So that's what the bells are about. (nodding at the boar) Do that to him.
scene.21: custodian|(from the pack) No. Not that one. Not yet.
custodian|His Blight is five deep. Your stone is at two. Go home and build.
wren|Then I'll wait. I'm good at it.
custodian|That is a pact. It paid first. They always do. See that you pay back.
scene.22: maren|(waking, not getting up) Forty sacks. I counted twice. Counting a third time won't help.
maren|The Mother's pumps gave us three crops a year. Then two. This year one, and a grey wood.
maren|You're the one from the hill. They say your field's green, and there's no pump in it.
maren|Show me a field that feeds people without one. Then I'll know what to say to the priests.
scene.23: aldric|(on a cart, arms raised) For the Ascended, who lit the way! Let it be lit again!
tamsin|Four stretches. There were three when I came to this valley.
scene.24: voice.girl|The fox says you're doing it wrong.
voice.boy|It's a fox. It doesn't say anything.
voice.girl|It says a great deal. Mostly about you.
voice.boy|(laughing) Then tell it I'll be king one day. It can say that to my face.
talk.vaults: custodian|There are more stones like that one. Three. I can feel them from here.
custodian|South-east, where the wheel turns. North-east, under the hill. West, under the roots.
custodian|Any order. I did not say they would be pleasant.
scene.25: calla|You went in alone. You are not to go in alone. It is in my instructions.
calla|For your safety. These places fall in. What did you find?
calla|A dead stone. They carry sickness. It is in my instructions.
calla|(writing) "One stone, destroyed." Thank you. That was the right thing to do.
calla|(writing) "Found nothing." (a look at your pack) Very well. Nothing.
scene.26: voice.old-woman|You'll be a lord one day, Auren. Lords don't carry pails.
auren|Then I will be a poor sort of lord, and your garden will be wet.
scene.27: maren|Seventy sheaves. On this ground. The best pumped field in my valley gave fifty-two.
maren|How? Do not say a miracle. I have had enough miracles this month.
gus|Soil is wet, and it rests. That is all it is. Nobody listens to soil.
aldric|Majesty, the pumps are the Mother's own gift. One cannot simply... a gift is not...
maren|Her gift gave me three thin harvests and a grey wood. Start pulling them out.
scene.28: auren|Six realms, and not one sword drawn all year. I didn't do that. You did.
scene.29: ilara|He wants to meet you. I said you are frightened of big things.
auren|I'm not frightened. I'm being respectful. From over here.
choice.gus: gus|Your arms cut the terrace. My field's next to it. Your machine or my hands.
gus|Machine, then. I'll find something else to do.
gus|My rows. Good. One in four rests.
took.mina.maproom: mina|One small ruin a day. I'll have it marked before you've had breakfast.
took.mina.survey: mina|Your farms, then. Every rate. I'll know your terrace better than you do.
scene.30: mina|The door opened and you didn't write. I had to hear it from a ferryman. A ferryman!
mina|Sixty years of delvers' notes on this valley. Every ruin they couldn't open.
mina|(looking at your hand) Couldn't. I'm going to need a bigger table.
custodian|There. Do you feel it? Look at the arch.
custodian|One Gate. As far as the town and no further. Do not be smug. There are seven.
scene.31.before: wren|He's still here. So am I. Don't tell me the number.
custodian|Five. It is five now. Break his guard. Then be kind to him.
scene.31: wren|(into his neck) You great fool. Two winters. You great fool.
wren|(not looking up) We're coming to live on your hill. He'll want a yard. Near water.
scene.32: calla|I will come down with you. It is in my instructions.
calla|(through the stone, very calm) That is not in my instructions.
scene.33.before: custodian|It will not know you. Chains do that. Break the pins. Hurt it no more than you must.
scene.33: stag|I go with you, small one. With you. Not for you.
custodian|(quietly) Hello, old friend. You have moss on you.
scene.34: maren|(at your gate, a charter in her hand) I had a speech. I've lost it.
maren|The valley round your door is yours. All of it, to the forest. Hold it better than we did.
scene.35: voice.a-voice|There you are. I have waited a long time to say thank you.
voice.a-voice|Rest now. There are five more to wake.
scene.36: elowen|You woke him gently. I heard. I am so glad it was gently.
elowen|Five more sleep. The Lion is next, in the desert, west along the High Road.
elowen|This writ opens every chapel door from here to the sea. Eat well. Sleep indoors.
elowen|And this is Ren, who asked to carry your water.
ren|(bowing too low) I can carry forty days of it. I have counted.
elowen|(to the town) Bless this child's road!
scene.38: tamsin|I'll mind the plot. Hobb will mind me.
tamsin|Out there they will tell you what the ruins mean. Look at the ruins yourself.
hobb|Bread for six days. Cheese for four. Eat the cheese first, Button.
hobb|And write. Not to Mina. To me.
dax|Gate'll be here when you get back. So will I.
wren|Bramble will keep the wood. (to your fox) You keep that one.
custodian|(from the pack) West, then. I have not been west in a thousand years. Walk smoothly.
memory.hall.again: voice.girl|Don't let him near the bees. He talks to them. They hate it.
voice.boy|One day there'll be water on every field in this valley. Uphill too.
memory.pumphouse.again: auren|Sit down, Nan. I'll fetch the other two.
memory.lampgallery.again: auren|Somebody fill the smith's cup before he makes a speech.
memory.seedvault.again: ilara|Put your hand flat. Flat. He isn't a dog.
hobb.need.bed: hobb|I'm sleeping on a sack of flour, Button. It isn't even good flour.
hobb.need.meal: hobb|Nothing in the pot tonight. First time in thirty years. I don't like it.
hobb.need.lamp: hobb|Can't tell the salt from the sugar after dark. Somebody's getting a sweet stew.
hobb.wish: hobb|Look at that. The river. Now I can watch the ferry and burn the onions.
hobb.burrow: hobb|You dug them out, didn't you. The ground's gone pale. Hope the copper was worth it.
hobb.hall: hobb|Breakfast first. That deed's not going anywhere. Nobody else wants it.
hobb.chapter2: hobb|Three mouths, one pot. I've fed forty wards on less. Don't make me prove it.
hobb.chapter3: hobb|Everyone on this hill ate today. Count them if you like. I did.
hobb.chapter4: hobb|Packed you a hot one, wrapped twice. Eat it before you go down. Not after.
hobb.fallback: hobb|The Mother sent pastries. I'm not saying they're bad. I'm saying I've had them.
dax.need.lamp: dax|Can't see the road. Can't watch what I can't see.
dax.wish: dax|Good post. I can see both. Thanks.
dax.hall: dax|Rack's in the yard. I'll be the crate lid.
dax.chapter2: dax|Fence held. Nothing came. Checked twice.
dax.chapter3: dax|Lamps are up. I slept. First time.
dax.chapter4: dax|Want me down there? No? I'll be at the gate.
mina.need.bed: mina|I slept on the map case. I've got the coast of Greenhollow printed on my face.
mina.need.meal: mina|I forgot to eat. No, wait. There was nothing to forget. That's different.
mina.need.lamp: mina|I can't draw in the dark. I tried. It's a very bad map.
mina.wish: mina|North light, no shadow on the paper. And the table fits the whole valley. Twice.
mina.hall: mina|Forty-one, forty-one... I've got the old survey somewhere. Don't touch the ladder.
mina.arrived: mina|That ruin by the mill isn't on any of the guild's maps. It's on mine now.
mina.maproom: mina|Today's is a sunk tower. One room. Probably. I'll know when you've been.
mina.chapter3: mina|Every farm you've got, at its best rate. Your terrace is showing off.
mina.chapter4: mina|Tell me everything about the Rootworks. Count the stairs. All of them.
mina.fallback: mina|West? Nobody's mapped the desert properly. Bring me back everything.
gus.need.bed: gus|Slept in the barn. Barn's fine. Barn's got a draught.
gus.need.meal: gus|No supper. A man can farm hungry. Not well.
gus.need.lamp: gus|Dark comes early here. Can't see my rows.
gus.wish: gus|Row's resting. Good. Come back in two weeks. You'll see.
gus.arm: gus|Machine's doing my rows. Off to town. Somebody there must want a farmer.
gus.grey: gus|Field's grey. Pump's still humming in it. Soil's not dead. Soil's tired.
gus.chapter3: gus|Wet it. Rest it. One row in four. Same as my father did.
gus.fallback: gus|Forest's green. Smell that? That's soil waking up.
wren.need.bed: wren|I slept in the yard with him. He snores. It's fine. It isn't fine.
wren.need.meal: wren|Bramble ate. I didn't. Get the order right next time.
wren.need.lamp: wren|No lamp by the yard. He wanders at night, and so do I, after him.
wren.wish: wren|Water right there. He's been in it since noon. Look at him.
wren.edge: wren|(to the boar first) Quiet today. (to you) Quiet's good. Means tired, not hungry.
wren.waiting: wren|Don't tell me. I'll know when you're ready. So will he.
wren.chapter3: wren|He ploughed half your east strip and fell asleep in it. That's a compliment.
wren.chapter4: wren|A chained beast fights the chain, not you. Stay out of the way of the chain.
wren.fallback: wren|The wood's loud again. I'd forgotten how loud.
tansy.need.bed: tansy|I slept with the hive. They don't mind. I do.
tansy.need.meal: tansy|Honey's not supper. People think it is. It isn't.
tansy.need.lamp: tansy|The bees go to bed at dusk. I don't. Light, please.
tansy.wish: tansy|The far row's all flowers. Thirty-one, and two I can't name.
tansy.took: tansy|You took. The bees knew before I did. I'll say it once.
tansy.arrived: tansy|Twenty flowers and nobody taking. You know how rare that is?
tansy.chapter3: tansy|Eleven, twelve, thirteen clover by the ditch. Up from nine. Don't mow it.
tansy.fallback: tansy|My hive by the wood is full. The wood's well. When it thins, you'll hear it from me first.
holt.need.bed: holt|I can sleep under a lamp post. I have. I'd rather not.
holt.need.meal: holt|A lamplighter eats at dusk, before the round. There was nothing at dusk.
holt.need.lamp: holt|A lamplighter with no lamp on his own door. People will talk.
holt.wish: holt|A lamp at the landing. Now the late ferry has something to steer by.
holt.arrived: holt|A lamp is a promise. Somebody walks toward it.
holt.chapter3: holt|That one by the bait field. Leave it dark. Some things need the dark.
holt|(looking at the arches) No. Ask me about any other lamp.
holt.fallback: holt|Every lamp on your hill lit at dusk. None of them on that road.
custodian.fox: custodian|The fox, first. Hold out the hand. It remembers that mark.
custodian.heart: custodian|Now the stone. Go and touch it. It does not bite. I checked.
custodian.sleep: custodian|Sleep. Up there, under your roof. I have slept enough for both of us.
custodian.pump: custodian|It still hums. I can hear it from in here.
custodian.hall: custodian|The stone does not get brighter while you stand and look at it.
custodian.chapter2: custodian|Brighter or dimmer. Those are the only two words I need from your day.
custodian.chapter3: custodian|Three vaults. I marked them. I did not say they would be pleasant.
custodian.chapter4: custodian|There is an old friend down there. I have not decided what to say.
custodian.fallback: custodian|West. I am told there is sand. I do not care for sand.
tamsin.axe: tamsin|No axe. I won't ask. (taking a spare off her belt) The guild sends its wardens spares.
tamsin.chapter2: tamsin|The Mother's kind. She's always been kind. Keep the glove on anyway.
tamsin.chapter3: tamsin|Another door sealed. That girl was always quick with wax.
tamsin.before: tamsin|Mind the wet planks. The jetty's older than the town.
tamsin.fallback: tamsin|Write to Hobb. She worries out loud. I don't.
maren.chapter2: maren|They crowned me at sixteen because I could add. Nobody said the adding never stops.
maren.pumps: maren|The priests are very polite to me now. Very. I'm counting that too.
maren.ledger: maren|Two pumps out. Granary's at forty-six. I'm writing it in ink.
maren.chapter3: maren|(not opening her eyes) If it's about the sacks, there are forty. Come back later.
maren.fallback: maren|You have a valley. I have a winter's bread. Fair trade. Sit down, I'm tired.
aldric.road: aldric|Tonight, on the road! You will come? Do come. Bring a... bring a cloak.
aldric.chapter2: aldric|Bless you. Is that... may I... no. No. Bless you.
aldric.chapter3: aldric|The pumps were a gift. One does not... a gift is not... Good day.
aldric.fallback: aldric|Every bell! I rang every bell. My arms are a gift to the Ascended now.
elowen.chapter2: elowen|Have you eaten? You have the look of someone who forgets.
elowen|Calla bites, a little. Somebody left her young. Be patient with her.
elowen.fallback: elowen|Look at you. A season ago you had a tent.
elowen|It is a long road. Write to your cook. Cooks worry.
calla.chapter2: calla|I will be near. You will not notice me. That is also in my instructions.
calla.nothing: calla|I wrote "found nothing". I have read it several times since.
calla.chapter3: calla|That door is sealed for your safety. Please do not pick at the seal.
calla.chapter4: calla|The gate did not open for me. I have written that down. It does not need a reason.
calla.fallback: calla|I am to report to the Mother. I have a great deal to report.
ren.fallback: ren|Forty days of water. Thirty-nine if you drink like the Stag.
ren|Where I'm from, a cup of water is a day's pay. Here you leave it lying in ditches.
ren|The Mother chose me. I want you to know I asked first.
grantday.porridge: hobb|Good. Now you'll last till noon. Dax is at the lock table.
